reviews.comment: She is very passionate about Chem, so if you're looking for an easy A she is not the prof for you. But, if you put in the effort, go to office hours, go to SI and show her that you put a lot of effort she will help your grade. She lowers her grade cut off to 87 for an A. Exams are def harder than other prof's. Pop quizzes in class so be prepared.

Dr. Schaefer is very moody. Her canvas is helpful since she posts videos of the lessons ahead of time and gives practice tests that prepare you well. She gives a lot of homework but it does help you know the content. There are random in class assignments so go to class. Do not rely on extra credit because she's very strict on grading it.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Schaefer is incredibly accessible outside of class between office hours, personal meetings, and study review sessions before exams. She gives weekly in class assignments. Plenty of extra credit offered, will help you with extra credit assignments as well. Homework sucks, but it always does. Curves final grades. Overall fair professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She was okay definitely could be worse but she can be INCREDIBLY passive aggressive and somewhat rude and mean. Her teaching style did not help me she just read off slides and her notes felt very vague. Her tests were doable and fair so as long as your actually learn the concepts on your own you should be okay. Does have 20 extra credit points.

I cannot stress this enough...please attend class! Being there while she solves problems is important. She releases videos online, but they don't always give the solutions, and her notes are hard to follow. She was very kind! I loved her! O-chem is a tough subject, but she made it very doable. I cannot thank her enough for the metacognitions.

Overall, she's a really good prof who clearly cares about her students. She gives plenty of opportunities for points in the class and the exams are extremely fair. She holds review sessions before each exam which are helpful. Ochem is difficult in general, but she does a great job of making it as easy as possible. I recommend her so much!!

I liked her but I struggled with ochem so I thought her teaching was a bit above my head. Office hours were helpful so go to those! Exams are very application based so know the mechanisms inside and out.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: O-chem is a hard class, but I think that she made it harder. She seems like a sweet person, but her exams are extremely harder compared to other professors. I went to her office hours, and she was really caring and helpful. GO TO CLASS!! Her lectures are a bit disorganized, but she teaches a certain way. She's ok, but take someone else if you can.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A lot of my test was regraded wrong, it's worth to check after every exam. Lecture was just off the notes given and I was forced to go to class due to the assignments at the end of class. Metacognition was helpful. I can see her as condescending to students but I didn't have an issue. Never heard anything about a curve or drop despite averages.

Condescending, rude, and arrogant in person and through email. Reads off slides (very unhelpful) and is very disorganized when it comes to prepping for exams, gives homework that is nothing like the exams

Lectures were pretty straightforward with fill-in notes provided and she taught fairly well. You have to do a lot of practice outside of class to prepare for the exams since there are so many moving parts, but she hosted pre-exam sessions to help. Free-response assignments at 8am were a little rough, especially over brand-new concepts, but short.

She is an overall ok prof, exams are VERY lecture heavy. Notes are often disorganized and confusing as she does not explain in detail and its common to teach yourself everything after class. Not a fan of end of class assignments cause you'll never know what's expected. Wouldn't recommend pls take another prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Pretty good prof. Lectures were clear and concise and assignments were fairly simple. The exams were difficult but she provides lots of opportunities for help through SIs, review sessions, and plenty of practice problems. I wasn't a fan of the quizzes she gave at the end of most of the lectures as I feel that I didn't get time to absorb the lecture

257: Completely slept on the professor, easily a top two choice for organic 1. Exams are fair, and she gives you two assignments to add 10 points to the exams of your choice. Outside of class, she is probably the most fun and caring professor I've had in college. I can not recommend her highly enough.

This class was my 13th reason why. I hated her lectures, as they were ridiculously boring and barely went over any of the content. I had to teach myself nearly everything in this class through reading the textbook. All of her slides come straight from the textbook, so she doesn't expand any further. I had to go to the CLL frequently.

Professor Schaefer's lectures were fast paced and at times disorganized, so I did a lot of self teaching in this course .She does offer extra credit in the form of metacognition exams, but she did not announce the curve at all, making the final exam more stressful, as I did not know what I needed to get on the test to get my desired grade.

Ochem is hard and her lectures aren't the clearest, but she gives practice questions after each chapter that set you up well for the exam. Up to 20 points you can get back on exams and she is super nice when you talk to her but can be a little passive aggressive. Her tests are pretty surface level compared to other profs.

At first she cared about her students and was a good lecturer. I am not sure what happened in November, but for the last 4-5 weeks of the semester she just wasn't the same person. Bitter and angry towards students and seemed to deflect responsibility. For weeks, she promised a 6-8% curve yet my 87.1% was still a B. She never announced the cutoffs.

Ochem is hard! She did not make it any easier. Exams are very test heavy. However, she does allow metacognition to earn some points back, BUT these meta- assignments are strictly graded and makes it difficult to earn all points back. Taught myself everything I know, her lectures are confusing. She is also very passive aggressive with students.

Dr. Schaefer was a very kind professor. She really cares about her students and she helps out a lot outside of class for students who need more help. The lectures can be fast or scattered at times, but she has videos that are recorded that help at times. Great practice exams, similar to exams. She gives lots of extra credit and curves the cutoff.

She was a very passive aggressive person and it was not enjoyable to talk to her. She gives extra points on each test and offers 20 points for metacognition. Cutoff for a A is 87. Her lectures are useless but she posts videos on each chapter which helps. Be prepared to spend a lot of time teaching yourself the information.

Boring lectures, rarely ever actually learned anything in the lecture. Class is test heavy but if you understand practice problems for each chapter and exam, you will be okay. iClicker will help with quizzes and homework were fairly easy. Grade is reflected on how determined you are to learn the material and are willing to work for your grade.

If you can, take her for Ochem 1. Ochem is already a harder class, so you have to work and study hard for an A. Personally, I just made quizlets and reviewed the lecture a few weeks before an exam and never scored lower than a 95. This class is mainly memorization of mechanisms, only thing that sucks is the amount of time she takes to grade.

The lectures were over a slideshow with a few iClicker questions. I had to teach majority of the material to myself. The course's VERY test heavy! Exams were very difficult and were not like any of the practices given to us. Exams were also heavily free response so if you are lost going into the exam, you will struggle. I recommend finding a tutor!

Her tests are 53% of your grade. The multiple homework assignments combined are only 6% of the grade and the final is 23%. Overall, had to teach myself almost everything. Complains the entire lecture making it pointless to go. Gaslights students into thinking everything we are doing is wrong when her key is wrong. I would take someone else.

She is very test heavy and tests are not like reviews or homework. Has an attitude. Lectures are pointless. Have to teach yourself or get a tutor. Does give iClicker for attendance worth 6% of total grade. The 20 homework assignments were also only worth 6%.

Super easy class as long as you pay attention. She might be the most unhappy person I've ever met but she makes the tests easy. Gives practice questions that resembles the exams, homework for extra credit, quizzes with multiple attempts. If you want a good ochem class take her.

Take Dr. Schaefer! She wants her students to do well. She will work with you and do her best to prepare you for everything Ochem will throw your way. She has videos on each topic, she makes them herself, and they are great to watch. She works hard to give you a great ochem experience. If you will put in the work, you will get the grade you deserve.
Awesome professor who is always accesible outside of class. She actually treated us like humans and gave extensions when life stuff happened.

Dr. Schaefer's lectures are pretty good and her practice exams are kind of similar to the actual exams. She sent out many emails saying that our class averages were much lower than her previous years and that she would adjust the final grade curve, but she refused to ever announce what the curve was so that people wouldn't ask her to round up.

She was a good teacher and ochem is not that bad honestly I studied very little and I got an A and I'm a psychology major so with this teacher you really have no excuse to not get an A. There was tons of bonus and anything above like an 87 was an A.

I never took AP chemistry in high school or really any APs. Got straight As in chem1, chem2, and ochem here at A&M. This class is completely doable DO NOT let yourself get discouraged by others. Take Schaefer, do the work, and you will do well.

I attended every lecture except for 1. She's very nice and accommodating. She got worse as the semester went on. She finishes lectures on Tuesday and exams are on Thursday. No time to study. It's unclear what will be on exams and she doesn't summarize. Would not have passed without SI.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: First off, OChem will be difficult but manageable. She tends to speed through lectures and it may be confusing. If you prefer to learn through doing problems, then you won't find many of them in lectures. So, try to attend classes to participate in her iClickers. Study from the practice problems and quizzes. Also, join the SI as it carried me.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Schaefer was a very accessible professor. Ochem is pretty tough, but being able to access her during office hours was very helpful. Her practice problems were very helpful, study those. Go to class, don't skip!!!!

Dr. Schaefer is very accessible and willing to help until you understand, whether it be via email or office hours. Sometimes she'd respond to emails at like 1 am and was never degrading. Very encouraging--she helped me realize my potential when I had doubts and didn't believe in myself. This is what sets her apart from other professors. Tests ~80%.

She is an amazing professor who truly wants you to succeed in her class. Ochem is a tough course so you have to study and put in the work to get a good grade. Her practice problems for each chapter are extremely helpful and you can do well if you put in the effort.

if people wanna hate please elaborate at least. It's a hard class and it took a while to adjust to a new learning style but she really does care a lot, she curves really well. The lectures are tricky to follow tbh, but the pre-recorded videos are very clutch. make flashcards.
the worst
Yeah no

She wasn't too bad, and her test are difficult, but very fair. If you are a visual learner, I wouldn't recommend Dr. Shaefer. She can make the content difficult to follow and understand, and she goes very quickly in her lectures. She's pretty funny too. I would plan to go SI and office hours on the regular after chapters 1-6 have been tested over

Dr. Schaefer is a great OChem prof. Her tests are pretty difficult and can be tricky at times but they are fair. She has a real passion for the subject and teaching. My only critique of her is that her lectures aren't very helpful, going to SI and studying the book will give you a greater understanding.

Dr. Schaefer is an extremely sweet person who cares about her students and respects them. However, I definitely do not recommend taking her. Lectures are mandatory and your grade is pretty much all based on exams/the final exam (homework and quizzes are a small percentage). The exams are extremely difficult and she goes very fast in lecture.

Her lectures are good, but a bit fast at some times. The class is difficult, but with proper studying you will be fine. The homework was not overbearing and was very useful in understanding the topics, along with the online quizzes.

Dr. Schaefer has made ochem significantly easier to understand. She provides lots of practice questions for each chapter. Quizzes can be difficult. Exams are challenging but very manageable if you work through the practice questions. I highly recommend Dr. Schaefer for this course. Great format, and it feels like she actually wants to succeed!
The rating given is not because I struggled in the class itself. This professor is hard to work with, inflexible, and overall a snotty person.

Dr. Schaefer is genuinely the kindest professor I have ever had. She cares so much about her students and wants everyone to do well in her class. She gives 5 exams but prepares you super well with practice sets. I am not going to lie, ochem is a very difficult class but Dr. Schaefer makes the class so much more manageable and less stressful.

Dr. Schaefer is awesome!! It's no secret that ochem is a very hard course but she makes it manageable and easy to understand. I consider her class easier than gen chem sometimes. Also, she's a super nice lady and is happy to help at all times. However, if you ever do act irritated towards her she will act it right back. Take her!!!!!

Difficult tests and hard grader
Does not teach (lectures are useless, learned more from 30 mins CLL than her all year)
Has temperamental issues
Not helpful even during office hours

I expected the class to be difficult, but the disorganization of the class was just frustrating. Assignments were consistently posted several days late with no extension to the due date so I found myself rushing to turn work in every week. The labs weren't too difficult to understand though and I enjoyed this course a lot more than Chem 231.

I took Dr. Schaefer for chem 227 over the summer. Her tests are hard, be prepared to study/practice often. During that semester I got sick. Really sick. She worked with me 100% and showed me supreme kindness.  I would take her for every chem class if I could.

CHEM 238 during Spring Semester. Prof Schaefer determines the assignments and grading procedure. The main portion of the course is done through the TA. Be very careful taking each assignment. Grading is done by a certain percentage of the class getting an A. Scoring above 90% is not applicable for A. Does curve.

CHEM 237 during Fall Semester. Prof Schaefer determines the assignments and grading procedure. The main portion of the course is done through the TA. Be very careful taking each assignment. Grading is done by a certain percentage of the class getting an A. Scoring above 90% is not applicable for A. Does curve.

Amazing prof, takes her time to explain things and tries her best to be engaging (every class she tells a joke as warm up). Tests are fair but hard. Make sure to practice every day! Multiple clicker questions per session. I got Covid + multiple health issues and she went above and beyond for me! Rec her so much!

Shes a really nice lady and tries to make the class bearable. This was my second time taking the class and she explains things really well!! She graded things pretty quickly. Was not really accessible and then got mad at the class when we did not email her out of her preferred hours of communication. 4 tests, final, hw and clicker questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Schaefer was by far one of the most unorganized professors I've ever had. There was an insane amount of work, all of which was graded extremely hard. We were sometimes told 3 different due dates for one assignment, and the expectations for papers was often unclear. Overall, just a very frustrating class that was way too time intensive.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I can't say much regarding her as a lecture prof, but as a lab coordinator, she's alright. She's unorganized, which is unfortunate considering how intensive this ochem lab is. She can come off as rude or short, but honestly, she just seems very stressed. If you talk with her one-on-one, she's helpful. Ngl, she's scary sometimes.

Dr. Schaefer has made our lab class beyond difficult. She's always unprepared, rude and condescending. We didn't have an ecampus page for the first month of classes and the syllabus is still incomplete. We're rarely informed of assignments and the expectations for lab reports and our bigger papers are often unclear. Please avoid if possible.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Schaefer had harder tests than other profs and were closed note, but she really helped me learn the material. She has a great personality and is very willing to help her students be as successful as possible. She truly cares.

Definitely one of the best profs ive ever had. The class is extremely difficult, but Schaefer really provides you with the support you need to do your best- She makes a lot of practice material both in lecture and before exams. Overall its obvious that shes so dedicated to her students. Take her class if you want to learn & youre willing to work.

Dr Schaefer is a solid choice for OCHEM. There were some complaints that tests were closed notes but if it were in person it wouldnt matter. Her tests were fair and she gave practice problems. Our averages were lower than others but she put a decent curve on the class. Ochem is not an easy class but she made it simple and was very accommodating

Your overall grade consist of 4 midterms, OWL HW, Reef Q's, Final exam. Closed note Exams but heard other Profs gave open note exams. Midterms weren't too different from prac probs ws & hw but can't rely on that for studying. Provides prac probs worksheets & is an OK lecturer but moved fast sometimes. Gave class a curve at end of the semester!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I have Dr. Schaefer right now and I love her! She always tells cute little jokes at the beginning of class which I enjoy. She is a good lecturer and going to office hours really helps if you are confused! Some of her exam questions are similar to owl, but by no means is this class easy. You will for sure have to study/work for an A.

Dr. Schaefer is a nice lady. That said, this class is ridiculous. Our exam average has been consistently below other sections all semester. She asks REEF polling questions during class when you still don't understand the material. She does not mute ZOOM calls during exams and the exams are the definition of a time crunch.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This woman will be short with you, accuse you of cheating in at least one of the papers from the mile-high pile of papers you WILL have to write, be completely unempathetic if you have any issues, put you down and insinuate that you're too stupid to understand the absurd and vague chemistry department rules. And insist that she's right to do so.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: One of the best profs I have ever had. Made the material easy to learn and understand despite teaching such a hard class. Tests were very fair overall and had very few to no curve balls. She was very accessible outside of class with generous office hours and easy to reach by email. She even told jokes in class to lighten the mood.

Dr. Schaefer was the best Prof I had at A&M! Ochem is difficult, but her lectures simplify the material. Above all, when the going got tough, she motivated me to keep going and to do my best. Not many profs do this, and she has made a profound impact on my undergrad career. Jokes before lectures and tests. Take her if you can; you wont regret it!

Dr. Schaefer is an amazing professor. She makes the material easier to understand and gives print outs of notes and practice problems to help with the already difficult subject. I wish I could take her for every science class.

Dr. Schaefer is a gift to Texas A&M. She has been one of the most impactful profs I've ever had, and few go above and beyond for their students like she does. The class itself is hard just because of the quantities of work required--you get through it by brute force. I'm glad it's over, but I'm thankful for having had the experience. Great TAs too!
I definitely recommend this professor! She's very down to earth, helpful, and makes the material easy to understand. Definitely my favorite professor that I've taken at TAMU this far.
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Shaefer has been the best professor I have had here at TAMU! She is funny and she truly cares about her students. Her tests are fair and she likes to tell jokes before starting the exams. I recommend going to office hours since she is easy to talk to and very helpful. I found that reading the book a couple of days before the test was helpful.

She is a good lecturer, starts every class with a joke. Notes are provided, it's easier to follow along with her notes and try to understand the material rather than try to write down you own notes. Quizzes every week to encourage attendance, takes top 14 quiz grades out of 20 in the course.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious
